proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The ambient groupoid (U, U times_S U, pr_1, pr_0, pr_02) makes the statement a special case of the map-groupoids version; a direct proof is also given. Writing U = Spec(k), view R, Z and U times_S U over k via s, pr_1|_Z, pr_1 (giving R_s, Z_s, U^2_s) and via t, pr_0|_Z, pr_0 (giving _tR, _tZ, _tU^2); j induces j_s : R_s to U^2_s and _tj : _tR to _tU^2 over k. In the commutative square with top arrow c from R_s times_k _tR to R and left vertical j_s times _tj, the closure of the image of j_s times _tj is Z_s times_k _tZ by the closure-image product-map lemma, and commutativity shows Z_s times_k _tZ maps into Z under the bottom horizontal arrow, which is the set theoretic containment pr_02(Z times over pr_1 and pr_0 of Z) inside Z. (source lines 1894-1924)
